34. GitHub Actions and CI

SIMPLE ENGLISH
GitHub Actions runs workflows defined in YAML in response to repository events. CI can build and
test pull requests before merge.

# .github/workflows/ci.yml (illustrative)
name: CI
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
Expected: A runner installs locked dependencies and executes tests; a failure marks the job failed.
What is CI? Frequent integration supported by automated build and test checks.
